Posting helper

Paste a submission, then copy one post at a time straight into the Bluesky composer.

How to use it
  1. Paste the submission you were sent and press Load.
  2. Open the Bluesky composer and start the thread.
  3. Hit Copy on Post 0, paste, attach the named file, add the alt text, then press + in the composer for the next post.
  4. Work down the list — each copied post greys out so you don't lose your place.

Pasting into the composer makes Bluesky resolve the @handles and links itself, so mentions notify people properly.

Loads as soon as you pick it.
